pretreatment: Al2O3 layer deposited over 100 cycles using trimethylaluminum (TMA) and ozone
evidence: The purpose of the Al2O3 layer was to twofold: I) To produce a reproducible, hydroxylated starting surface 55 for each cobalt oxide film deposition and II) to cover and thus passivate cobalt oxide that would grow on the ALD reactor walls and eventually cause ozone decomposition.
